correctness.rationale: The GL_n action on nonzero vectors and independent ordered pairs gives the first and second factorial moments; distinct proportional idempotents are impossible. In odd characteristic support-r square collisions contribute (q-1)(2^(r-1)-1) nonproportional partners and sum to B=(q-1)((2q-1)^n-2q^n+1)/2; Frobenius in characteristic two has no exceptional independent pairs. n=1 is excluded correctly. Independent direct GL enumeration over GF(2)^3 and GF(3)^2, GF(3)^3 gave variances 1,5/6,23/26, respectively.
residual_risks: Exhaustion for these small cases corroborates, not a proof for arbitrary n or prime powers.
